description: Renew the third-party authorization of an organization's Slack or Telegram channel, for a channel whose workspace access was revoked or whose bot scopes changed. The step happens in a browser or a terminal, so the answer names the Integrations page and the `valet channels reauthorize` command and changes nothing itself. A channel with no credentials (cron, heartbeat, webhook, email, mcp) is refused. Requires connecting a Valet account.

channel.description: The channel's name in the organization.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the channel belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: reauthorize_channel

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

step.description: What the person does in a browser, such as authorizing a service. Nothing has changed until they do it.

url.description: Address of the page where the person finishes the step. Absent when the page has no address to give.

title: Reauthorize a channel
